usedFor: Mobile Text Alerts holds your replies, and Google Docs logs them through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “SMS Reply Received” in Mobile Text Alerts, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each reply from a recipient is written into a Google Docs tab, so replies are readable in one place.

watchOut: Choose add over replace in “Add or Replace Text In Tab”, or each new reply overwrites the earlier ones.
